question:
The area of a sphere is 1386 cm². What is the radius of the sphere?

[Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

The surface area of the sphere = 1386 cm2

Formula used:

The surface area of a sphere = 4πr2

Calculations:

The surface area of a sphere = 4πr2

⇒ 4πr2 = 1386

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r2 = 1386

⇒ r² = (1386 × 7)/(4 × 22)

⇒ r² = (63 × 7)/4 = 441/4

⇒ r² = √(441/4) = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
